name: Dawn Regalia (Drakniss signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of ivory and {{PRIMARY}} silk with a fitted bodice embroidered with {{METAL}} sunbursts, a high halo-shaped collar of {{METAL}} rays, long sleeves of sheer gold-dusted gauze, and a skirt of pleated panels that fan out like rays of light behind her; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
